screening_decisions.reason: Intravenous clomipramine, not orally administered. Review requires oral tricyclics.
Fluoxetine is an SSRI, not a tricyclic drug.
RCT of nortriptyline (tricyclic) vs placebo in depressed adolescents aged 12-17, orally administered.
Narrative review, not a randomised controlled trial.
Double-blind placebo-controlled pilot of oral imipramine in depressed children. Despite small sample, meets design, drug, and population criteria.
Double-blind crossover RCT of amitriptyline (tricyclic) vs placebo in children 9-12 with major depression, oral route.
Review of newer generation (non-tricyclic) antidepressants; not an RCT of a tricyclic drug.
RCT of oral imipramine plus CBT vs placebo plus CBT in adolescents with comorbid depression. Compares a tricyclic to placebo in depressed 6-18-year-olds.
Double-blind, placebo-controlled RCT of oral imipramine in prepubertal children (likely 6-12) with major depression.
Three-arm RCT that includes imipramine (tricyclic) vs placebo in depressed adolescents; tricyclic comparator meets criteria.
Review article on mechanisms of action; not an RCT.
Study of SSRI overdose safety, not an efficacy trial of a tricyclic vs placebo.
Methodological paper on measuring inconsistency in meta-analyses; not a primary RCT.
Case series of amitriptyline intoxication; not a randomised controlled efficacy trial.
Secondary analysis examining predictors of response; not a primary RCT comparing a tricyclic to placebo.
Randomised, placebo-controlled trial of oral desipramine (tricyclic) in adolescents aged 13-18 with major depression.
Review/perspective article; not an RCT.
Contains a double-blind, placebo-controlled trial comparing imipramine (tricyclic) to placebo in children/adolescents with school refusal and depression.
Poisoning case series; not an efficacy trial.
Double-blind, placebo-controlled RCT of oral amitriptyline in adolescents 12-17 with major depression.
Double-blind trial of oral clomipramine (tricyclic) in children with school refusal and neurotic disorder; abstract notes rapid relief of depression, so inclusion justified.
Adult population (aged 18-65) and meta-analysis, not an original RCT in children/adolescents.
Open trial without a placebo comparator; not an RCT.
RCT of oral amitriptyline (tricyclic) vs placebo in adolescents with treatment-resistant major depression.
Secondary analysis focusing on compliance and side effects; not a primary efficacy trial reporting tricyclic vs placebo outcomes.
